checks.name: PDF visual inspection: Lin page 4 Fig 3 caption and reporter separation
PDF visual inspection: Amin page 11 Fig 7 labels, normalization and n

scope: Primary-source documentation and source-file integrity only. No neural/model execution, fitting, new digitization, or current intervention-outcome interpretation.
source_access: Official EuropePMC full-text archival XML and eLife PDF/source workbooks; Lin published PDF from corresponding-author lab website. Direct PMC browser access presented a recaptcha; archival fulltext succeeded. No institutional login used.

electrical.classification: author-stated prior somatic electrophysiology, not a new electrical experiment in Amin or Lin
electrical.finding: Adult APL described as non-spiking; active conductances elsewhere not ruled out.

lin_fig3.measurement: reported maximum fluorescence fraction ΔF/F, not percent or mV

amin_fig5_7.measurement: APL or KC GCaMP6f ΔF/F, separate reporter cohorts
amin_fig5_7.fig7_additional_normalization: largest absolute segment/data-point response across matching conditions, columns 2+3 or 4+5
amin_fig5_7.time_windows: Figure 6 gray windows; precise numeric window endpoints not newly extracted
amin_fig5_7.distance_definition: normalized mushroom-body backbone; different from APL neurite geodesic distances used in anatomical model
amin_fig5_7.release_evidence: GABA puff comparison and calcium localization support local release indirectly, without measuring its concentration or transfer function

author_model.classification: phenomenological author fit to spatial reporter profiles and hemibrain anatomy; no independent measurement of APL Rm/Ra
author_model.known_model_limit: static distance attenuation omits dynamic feedback; simple backbone alternative has 25 um preferred at vertical site, 50 um at horizontal/calyx
author_model.two_mV_statement: Release modulation in other insect nonspiking interneurons, cited to Burrows/Siegler; not an APL threshold

lin_population_behavior.neural_observation: fluorescence pixel-map population sparseness and odor-vector correlation
lin_population_behavior.behavior: post-training minus pre-training proportion of time in CS-minus; separate behavioral cohort/task

preparation.Lin: male and female, 1-7 days; exposed superfused brain for imaging; temperature/transgene controls
preparation.Amin: head opened and superfused for volumetric imaging; sex and age not located in inspected main-text methods, not asserted absent from every supplement
preparation.cross_cohort_warning: No sex-specific biological transfer or equivalence of different reporters/preparations

workbook_caption_mismatch: Published Fig 7 source-data caption names figure supplement 2, but workbook literal second sheet is Fig 7-supp1. Preserved without relabeling.
missing_laws: local KC input to APL voltage and unitary synaptic kinetics
APL calcium/voltage to vesicle release or GABA concentration
KC GABA receptor efficacy, kinetics and reversal including possible selective calcium effects
APL local membrane capacitance/resistivities and active conductances
appropriate MaleCNS subcellular geometry/transfer of hemibrain findings
future_assay_only: Freeze three stimulus sites, finite input footprints, reporter normalization and comparison windows; reserve a site to check simultaneous APL-calcium and KC-suppression predictions. Data already inspected; no blind validation claim.
render_warnings: Lin Poppler emitted Invalid Font Weight and insufficient arguments for Marked Content; inspected Figure 3 caption and plotted labels remain legible and agree with archival XML.
limitations: Checks confirm source/documentation consistency, not biological model validity.
No quantitative reduction of source workbooks, electrophysiological parameter fit, calcium-to-rate/conductance conversion or new experiments.
Existing optional graded backend not evidence of APL-specific physiological parameters.
